test:
assert is_even(2) is True
assert is_even(3) is False
assert is_even(0) is True

assert reverse_string('abc') == 'cba'
assert reverse_string('') == ''
assert reverse_string('a') == 'a'

assert max_of_three(1,5,3) == 5
assert max_of_three(-1,-5,-3) == -1
assert max_of_three(2,2,2) == 2

assert count_vowels('hello') == 2
assert count_vowels('AEIOU') == 5
assert count_vowels('bcdfg') == 0

assert fibonacci(0) == 0
assert fibonacci(1) == 1
assert fibonacci(10) == 55

assert is_palindrome('racecar') is True
assert is_palindrome('No lemon no melon') is True
assert is_palindrome('hello') is False

assert sum_digits(123) == 6
assert sum_digits(0) == 0
assert sum_digits(999) == 27

assert remove_duplicates([1,2,2,3]) == [1,2,3]
assert remove_duplicates([]) == []
assert remove_duplicates(['a','b','a']) == ['a','b']

assert find_min([3,1,2]) == 1
assert find_min([-5,-2,-9]) == -9
assert find_min([7]) == 7

assert count_words('hello world') == 2
assert count_words('  a  b  c  ') == 3
assert count_words('') == 0

assert is_prime(2) is True
assert is_prime(9) is False
assert is_prime(17) is True

assert factorial(0) == 1
assert factorial(5) == 120
assert factorial(1) == 1

assert gcd(12, 18) == 6
assert gcd(7, 13) == 1
assert gcd(0, 5) == 5

assert count_occurrences([1,2,3,2,2], 2) == 3
assert count_occurrences([], 1) == 0
assert count_occurrences(['a','a'], 'a') == 2

assert capitalize_first('hello') == 'Hello'
assert capitalize_first('') == ''
assert capitalize_first('x') == 'X'

assert sum_list([1,2,3]) == 6
assert sum_list([]) == 0
assert sum_list([-1,1]) == 0

assert is_sorted([1,2,3]) is True
assert is_sorted([3,1,2]) is False
assert is_sorted([]) is True

assert to_binary(0) == '0'
assert to_binary(5) == '101'
assert to_binary(255) == '11111111'

assert starts_with('hello', 'he') is True
assert starts_with('hello', '') is True
assert starts_with('hello', 'lo') is False

assert swap_case('Hello') == 'hELLO'
assert swap_case('ABC') == 'abc'
assert swap_case('123') == '123'

assert has_duplicates([1,2,3]) is False
assert has_duplicates([1,2,1]) is True
assert has_duplicates([]) is False

assert second_largest([1,3,2]) == 2
assert second_largest([5,5,4,3]) == 4
assert second_largest([10, 20, 30, 40]) == 30

assert flatten_once([[1,2],[3,4]]) == [1,2,3,4]
assert flatten_once([]) == []
assert flatten_once([[1],[],[2,3]]) == [1,2,3]

assert intersection([1,2,3],[2,3,4]) == [2,3]
assert intersection([],[1]) == []
assert intersection([1,2],[3,4]) == []

assert is_anagram('listen','silent') is True
assert is_anagram('abc','abd') is False
assert is_anagram('Dormitory','Dirty room') is True

assert longest_word('a bb ccc') == 'ccc'
assert longest_word('') == ''
assert longest_word('same same') == 'same'

assert multiply_all([2,3,4]) == 24
assert multiply_all([]) == 1
assert multiply_all([-1,5]) == -5

assert is_perfect_square(16) is True
assert is_perfect_square(15) is False
assert is_perfect_square(0) is True

assert rotate_left([1,2,3,4], 1) == [2,3,4,1]
assert rotate_left([1,2,3], 5) == [3,1,2]
assert rotate_left([1], 3) == [1]

assert zip_sum([1,2],[10,20]) == [11,22]
assert zip_sum([],[ ]) == []
assert zip_sum([3],[4]) == [7]

assert first_unique('leetcode') == 'l'
assert first_unique('aabb') == ''
assert first_unique('abca') == 'b'

assert prefix_sum([1,2,3]) == [1,3,6]
assert prefix_sum([]) == []
assert prefix_sum([5]) == [5]

assert last_element([1,2,3]) == 3
assert last_element([]) is None
assert last_element(['x']) == 'x'

assert count_positives([1,-2,3,0]) == 2
assert count_positives([]) == 0
assert count_positives([-1,-2]) == 0

assert merge_sorted([1,3],[2,4]) == [1,2,3,4]
assert merge_sorted([],[1,2]) == [1,2]
assert merge_sorted([1,1],[1]) == [1,1,1]
